description: This file defines a C# interface 'IFaultableConsumerGrain' within the namespace 'UnitTests.GrainInterfaces'. The interface extends 'IGrainWithGuidKey' and declares asynchronous methods related to stream consumption and fault handling, such as becoming a consumer, setting failure periods, stopping consumption, and retrieving counts of processed and failed items.

classes.name: IFaultableConsumerGrain
classes.description: A C# interface representing a faultable consumer grain in Orleans, providing methods for managing stream consumption, failure periods, and retrieving consumption metrics.

methods.name: BecomeConsumer
methods.description: Initializes the grain as a consumer for a specific stream identified by streamId and streamNamespace, using the specified provider.

methods.name: SetFailPeriod
methods.description: Sets the period during which the grain is considered to be failing.

methods.name: StopConsuming
methods.description: Stops the grain from consuming stream data.

methods.name: GetNumberConsumed
methods.description: Returns the total number of items consumed by the grain.

methods.name: GetNumberFailed
methods.description: Returns the total number of failed consumption attempts.

methods.name: GetErrorCount
methods.description: Returns the count of errors encountered during consumption.
